project.name: 300 mm Roman pillar with continuous marble relief
project.notes: Prefer separate base, shaft, and capital; use continuous cylindrical mapping on shaft.

casting.body_or_product: Select exact casting plaster and follow its datasheet

printer.material: PETG or PLA case material after compatibility test

mold.parting_strategy: Base, shaft, capital as separate casting modules; 2-4 vertical sectors; capital 4 sectors or silicone skin.

acceptance: Final assembled height within 1.5 mm of 300 mm
No visible texture rotation between shaft sectors
No bubble larger than 1 mm at capital leaf tips
All sections demold without chipping the relief
